newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SANGAR TO SEEK LISTING ON TSE - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: SANGAR TO SEEK LISTING ON TSE - REPORT.

text.p: Sangar STC, a clothing manufacturer, will seek a listing on the Tallinn stock exchange's (TSE) secondary market in 1997, the Aripaev business paper said on Wednesday.

"The shareholders changed the company's articles of association and this made it possible for the company to take its shares to the bourse," Sanger board member Maia Palsi was quoted as saying by Aripaev.
The newspaper added that the company hoped to eventually make the TSE's main list.
The sewing company is the largest manufacturer of shirts in Estonia with a turnover of 38.8 million kroons in 1996 and a forcasted turnover of 44.5 kroons for 1997.
The company's profit in 1996 was 1.8 million kroons with estimates of three million kroons for 1997, the paper added.
The company has a share capital of four million kroons and 285 share holders.
The company's plans in 1997 include opening its own stores in Tallinn and possibly in Riga, Latvia.
